## Research focus

My thesis explores scalable data-pipeline design, contrasting batch and stream
processing and describing an implementation with Apache Kafka and Apache Flink.
The research objective is to examine streaming graph processing in Flink,
including its performance and scalability.

This summary follows the thesis description on my
[LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raxit65535/). The ProQuest record
confirms the title, author, institution, year, and publication number; this page
does not present a new evaluation or independently reproduced benchmark.

## Related repository and attribution

The [Network Pulse / Git Archive project page](../../contributions/git-archive/index.qmd)
records the provenance of the related repository in my account. That repository
is a fork, and its upstream implementation remains credited separately from my
authorship of this thesis.
